name: wa-whatsapp-agent
description: Build, deploy, and maintain a WhatsApp AI agent - step by step, no coding required, on Mac or Windows. Guides non-technical users through connecting WhatsApp via Green API, building an AI-powered conversational agent, deploying to Render.com, connecting tools, and ongoing maintenance. Self-updating: verifies volatile provider facts at runtime, reports drift, and upgrades bots built with older versions.
